notes.title: The FATE Team is asking questions again...share your thoughts!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Adventurers!
[/b]

Once again, the Holidays are upon us, and we want to wish every one of you the very best. Everyone who has taken on the challenge to help out the town of Grove over these many years is truly appreciated by our team. 

As the end of this year comes to a close, we would like to ask you to participate in conversations on our various social accounts. We know not everyone uses the same Social Media, so we will utilize Linktree to share out all the different channels we use. Please make sure to follow us on your preferred platform and engage with the upcoming posts (And no, they are not all going to be about sales ːpraisesunː ).


 [url=https://linktr.ee/fatefranchise]FateFranchise[/url]


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37907267/0aae5cc93eb2f4cd0969cb4242cf4f6a64f47538.png[/img]

Again, thank you for all your cherished memories of FATE, and we look forward to speaking with you, our community, even more in 2022!

-FoG ːyourFateː
